name: Crispy Chicken Salad with Carrot, Apple, Cheddar, Avocado & Honey Mustard Dressing (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Place mayo and spices in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp mayonnaise
¼ tsp paprika
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Slice crosswise into ¾-inch thick strips, add to the bowl with the mayo, and toss to coat.

Add bread crumbs to the bowl with the chicken and toss once more to coat. Arrange chicken on a baking sheet pan and drizzle with oil. Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until golden brown and cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup panko bread crumbs
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, using a clean cutting board, cut buns into 1-inch cubes.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread cubes and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat, season with salt and pepper, then set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the croutons are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place mayo, honey, mustard, vinegar, and spices in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing, then place ¼-cup in a small bowl and set aside for the kid plates.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp mayonnaise
2 tbsp honey
1 tbsp yellow mustard
1 tsp apple cider vinegar
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp paprika
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the medium bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Quarter and core apples. Thinly slice half of an apple and place on a plate for the kids. Small dice remaining apple and add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add a ⅓-cup to the plate with the apple. Add remaining carrot to the bowl.
Medium dice cheese. Add half to the plate. Add remaining cheese to the bowl, along with the pumpkin seeds, and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (227 g) block cheddar cheese
⅛ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide about ⅓ of the chicken strips, a ⅓-cup of croutons, apple slices, grated carrot, and cheese cubes between plates. Serve with honey mustard dressing for dipping. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with remaining chicken and croutons. Enjoy!
